stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition snapshot 15w44b in a local single-player Creative-mode world, using keyboard and mouse. Subtitles must be enabled, and the Master Volume and Jukebox/Note Blocks volume controls must be above 0%. No dedicated server, additional players, commands, seed, or coordinates are required.
preconditions: Install and launch the exact Java Edition snapshot 15w44b rather than the fixed snapshot 20w14a or a modern release.
Allow the launcher to finish downloading the snapshot's standard assets before beginning the test.
Use the standard game resources without a resource pack that replaces music, sound events, subtitle definitions, or language files.
Make sure the game window is large enough for the subtitle display on the lower-right side of the HUD to be visible.
Make sure the operating system has an available audio output device so record playback can be distinguished from a failed jukebox interaction.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, select the installation for Java Edition snapshot 15w44b and start the game. Do not substitute 15w44a, 15w45a, or the fixed snapshot 20w14a.
steps.success_cue: The main-menu version text identifies the running game as Minecraft 15w44b.

steps.action: From the main menu, select Singleplayer, select Create New World, set Game Mode to Creative, and create the world. The world name and seed may remain at their defaults.
steps.success_cue: The player enters a newly created world and has the Creative-mode HUD, including no health or hunger bars.

steps.action: Wait before configuring the test until the nearby terrain has rendered and inventory and movement input respond normally.
steps.success_cue: Nearby blocks are visible, the player can turn and move without world-loading pauses, and the Creative inventory opens when E is pressed.

steps.action: Press Esc, select Options, select Music & Sounds, and click the Show Subtitles control until it reads ON. Return to the game without disabling this option.
steps.exact_input: Esc -> Options -> Music & Sounds -> Show Subtitles: ON
steps.success_cue: The Show Subtitles control visibly reads ON before the options menus are closed.

steps.action: While still in Music & Sounds, make sure Master Volume and the Jukebox/Note Blocks volume category are both above 0%; a clearly audible setting such as 100% is preferred. Then select Done until gameplay resumes.
steps.success_cue: Gameplay has resumed, subtitles remain enabled, and neither relevant volume control is muted.

steps.action: Press E to open the Creative inventory. Open the Search Items tab, click its search field, enter "Jukebox", and move one Jukebox item into an empty hotbar slot. The hotbar is the row of nine item slots at the bottom of the inventory.
steps.success_cue: A Jukebox item is present in one of the nine hotbar slots.

steps.action: Clear the Creative inventory search field, enter "Music Disc", and locate the disc whose tooltip identifies the track as C418 - 13. Move that disc into a different empty hotbar slot.
steps.success_cue: The hotbar contains both a Jukebox and the music disc for track 13 in separate slots.

steps.action: Press E to close the inventory. Select the hotbar slot containing the Jukebox by pressing its corresponding number key or scrolling the mouse wheel. Aim at the top face of a nearby solid ground block and right-click once to place the Jukebox.
steps.success_cue: A Jukebox block is placed on the ground within the player's interaction range.

steps.action: Select the hotbar slot containing the C418 - 13 music disc. Keep the crosshair centered on the placed Jukebox and verify that no other menu covers the HUD.
steps.success_cue: The music disc is visible in the player's hand, the Jukebox is under the crosshair, and the normal HUD including the subtitle area is visible.

steps.action: Right-click the placed Jukebox once with the C418 - 13 music disc to insert the disc and start its record sound. Do not click the Jukebox again, because a second interaction can eject the disc. Immediately hand control to the observation subsystem.
steps.success_cue: The Jukebox accepts the disc and record playback begins; the disc is no longer shown in the player's hand as an available hotbar item.

stor.handoff_condition: The C418 - 13 music disc has just been inserted into the placed Jukebox in Minecraft 15w44b while Show Subtitles remains ON and the subtitle HUD is unobstructed. Begin observing the subtitle area immediately without ejecting the disc or triggering additional sounds.
uncertainties: The report contains no formal setup or Steps to Reproduce section and combines many unrelated missing-subtitle sound events accumulated across multiple versions.

Many sounds in the current description were added after the recommended first affected version, Minecraft 15w44b. Therefore, this plan uses the explicitly listed record sound record.13 rather than a later sound such as a 1.9 player attack sound.

The report does not specify a game mode, world seed, coordinates, or server environment. A local Creative-mode world is selected as the simplest deterministic way to obtain a Jukebox and music disc without introducing crafting or exploration.
This procedure reproduces one representative sound from the report's affected list. It does not attempt to trigger every sound listed in the description and comments.
The report notes that background music and records may have been intentionally unsubtitled, but that question concerns issue evaluation and does not change the execution path requested here.
